title: Flow Service Management: use native HttpClient instead of Web Request Helper
summary: Flow Service Management now uses native HttpClient instead of Web Request Helper codeunit, removing dependency on legacy HTTP infrastructure while maintaining identical behavior.
key_points: Replaces Web Request Helper.GetResponseTextUsingCharset with native HttpClient implementation
Maintains original behavior including Bearer token handling and UTF-8 charset detection
Removes last caller of Web Request Helper, enabling obsolescence of codeunit 1299
Prerequisite for future web request refactoring
No public API or behavior changes
